name: ide-lemminx
author: lumine-code
description: Provide XML intelligence with Eclipse LemMinX.

serverJar.title: Server JAR
serverJar.description: Absolute path to the complete LemMinX uber JAR. Leave empty to use the managed installation, then LEMMINX_JAR.

javaPath.title: Java Path
javaPath.description: Absolute path to a Java 11 or newer java executable. Leave empty to use JDK_HOME, JAVA_HOME, then PATH.

maxHeap.title: Maximum Heap
maxHeap.description: Maximum memory in MiB for each XML language server.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Offer to install LemMinX when its server or a supported Java runtime cannot be found.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which supported XML features the editor uses.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report XML syntax and schema validation errors.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Complete XML elements and attributes from schemas.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show element and attribute schema documentation.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Navigate XML elements in the current document.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename matching tags and schema declarations.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Apply XML syntax and validation fixes.

catalogs.title: XML Catalogs
catalogs.description: Catalog file paths or URLs for resolving schemas and DTDs. Relative paths resolve from the project folder.

fileAssociations.title: File Associations
fileAssociations.description: Associate document filename patterns with schema or DTD paths or URLs.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Filename pattern to associate, including * and ? wildcards.

systemId.title: Schema or DTD
systemId.description: Schema or DTD file path or URL for matching documents.

splitAttributes.title: Split Attributes
splitAttributes.description: Put each XML attribute on its own line when formatting. Server Default preserves the upstream default.
